entities.summary: Jan Choinski is a German-born Polish-British tennis player who competes mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour. Choinski has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 120 achieved on 30 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 622 achieved on 7 January 2019. He is currently the No. 4 singles player from Great Britain. Since 2019, he represents Great Britain.
